name: 02072 · Stoughton, MA
findings: ZIP 02072 (Stoughton) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02072 (Stoughton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02072 (Stoughton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
